setup.baseline: Custom Race wizard in the supplied executable.
setup.variable: Walk all six steps with a neutral race; record every visible field, its range and default.

procedure: Open the custom-race wizard from the New Game dialog and from File > Custom Race Wizard.
Record all fields and controls on steps 1-6, including disabled controls and defaults.
For each numeric control, record minimum, maximum, step and default by keyboard and mouse.
Select each immunity option and record which range controls disappear and how advantage points change.
Attempt Finish with a negative balance, then a zero balance, and record validation messages.
Save a race file and reopen it to confirm round-trip behavior.

documented: Step 1 defines race type, name, password, emblem and leftover-point spending; the dialog shows up to 50 leftover points in the supplied template caption.
Step 2 selects a primary trait; step 3 selects lesser traits; step 4 sets habitable ranges, immunities and growth rate (help states 1%-20%).
Step 5 sets population efficiency for colonists, factories, mines and defenses; step 6 sets research-cost choices for six fields.
Finish verifies a valid race, re-prompts for the password and opens Save As.
Predefined races preset steps 2-6 in the original help.

unresolved: Exact control ranges for step 5 are not decoded.
The one-primary and zero-or-more-lesser rule is supported by dialog styles, but valid combinations and exclusions are unknown.
Version applicability of the January 1998 help is unresolved.
notes: Product policy excludes selectable predefined-race presets; that exclusion is a design decision, not a documented claim.
